column1: # *** RECORDS READ ABOUT A NAMED PERSON, SO THAT THEIR OWN PAGE CAN SAY SO. ***
# Created 17 September 2026 after a fault found in the Mazza archive was looked for here and found in
# a different shape. *** This archive had no slug-keyed evidence file at all: a person page is built
# from lerena-register.tsv and relations.tsv and NOTHING ELSE. *** So a whole session's worth of
# records could be written into topic files, rendered on topic pages, and never reach the person -
# whose page went on saying "No relationships are recorded for this person. The source names them and
# nothing more." *** That is what it was doing for Cipriano and Vitalino of Trinidad while this archive
# held their wives, their children and their parents. ***
# person: MUST match a name in lerena-register.tsv exactly. The build FAILS if it does not - it does
#   not skip the row, which is the mistake relations.tsv makes.
# The build attaches these to the person and the page renders them under "What has been read".
person
Cipriano LERENA (of Trinidad)
column2: *** HIS PARENTS: MAURICIO LERENA and CASIMIRA MONTANA. *** Death registration of 1928 at Flores, record 40, entry 1, page 20v. *** This makes him a grandson of Ramon Serena of Valdemoro and a first cousin of Bernabe. *** Indexed only - the card says "Image Unavailable", so the act itself has not been read.

column1: Vitalino LERENA (of Trinidad)
column2: Named again as a father on the death entry of *** ROSAURA FULGENCIA LERENA *** at Trinidad - "parents Vitalino Lerena, Andrea Atcheverre". *** The mother's Basque surname is spelled Echeverry, Echeverse, Etcheverre and Atcheverre across four records of one family. ***

column1: Bernabe LERENA (of Trinidad)
column2: *** Named as a father on his son's marriage act: *** "Fausto G. Lerena, born 1880, married 7 April 1900 at *** SANTISIMA TRINIDAD, Trinidad, Flores ***, parents *** BERNABE LERENA and CASIMIRA PELAEZ. ***"

column1: Dona Casimira PELAEZ (wife of Bernabe LERENA)
column2: Named as the mother on the same 1900 marriage act of her son Fausto G. Lerena at Trinidad. *** The Lerenas and Pelaezes of Trinidad intermarried until the church required a dispensation for consanguinity in 1885. ***

column1: Sancho LLERENA Aguilar
column2: *** HIS SON'S BAPTISM NAMES HIS OWN PARENTS. *** Luis Escolastico, baptised Iglesia Matriz, Montevideo, 10 February 1811 - "abuelos paternos *** FELIZ GERENA y ROSALIA AGUILAR ***". *** And the 1812 act of a DIFFERENT family, one year later at the same font, writes ITS grandfather "SALVADOR GERENA" *** - the same clerk-world spelling, which is why the two houses had to be told apart by where they came from rather than by how they were written.

column1: Avelino LERENA Fernandez (son of Sancho)
column2: *** His son ALBERTO's death is now on a record, not a tree. *** Montevideo civil registration, *** certificate 246 ***, death 1 March 1921: "Alberto Lerena, 69, born about 1852, father *** AVELINO LERENA ***, mother *** AMBROSIA TREIBEL ***, wife Maria Ines Larriera." *** The archive held the Lerena Traibel children on FamilySearch tree IDs; this is the first of them with a register behind it. ***

column1: Justa Pastora LERENA (daughter of Sancho)
column2: Her marriage act, re-read from the index 17 September 2026: *** "Justa Pastora Llerena, natural de CANELONES, residente en el CORDON, soltera - 3 November 1830, Iglesia San Pablo, Cordon, Montevideo, certificate 3 - hija de SANCHO LLERENA y MARIA FERNANDEZ" ***, marrying *** MANUEL BARROS, natural de PERNAMBUCO ***. *** Already held from the 1831 Cordon act; recorded here because a record about a person belongs on her page. ***

column1: Mary Septima TAYLOR
column2: *** HER BIRTH REGISTRATION, FOUND. *** Births, December quarter 1884, *** BIDEFORD, volume 5b page 506 *** - a birth on 17 September registered within the six weeks the law allowed falls in the December quarter. *** The woman who married Pablo Armando at St Dominic's, Wynberg, on 3 September 1911 now has her own birth on an index. ***

column1: Mary Septima TAYLOR
column2: *** Her nine brothers and sisters were all found in the same index and then followed to their deaths *** - and four married surnames came out of it: Isabella Temple married *** HENRY DALLING ***, Lucy Elizabeth married *** WILLIAM NORRISH SWEET ***, Irene married *** HENRY ALBERT BURTON ***, Agnes Walker married *** ALFRED S WOOD ***. *** Mary Septima is the only one of the ten who is not in the English death index: she died at Cape Town in 1935. She is the one who left. ***
